about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Trades-first bank lesson 8 ('Half your competitors ignore their reviews', research/runs/2026-10-28-trades-insights.md); replaces the old review-replies lesson (Proserpio and Zervas, hotels on TripAdvisor, a non-trade study). The page below re-read with WebFetch on Oct 28, 2026 (America/Chicago), and only what it says is used.

achr.title: 91% of Homeowners Rely on Online Reviews Before Picking Contractors
achr.publisher: The ACHR News (HVACR trade paper), study by Clear Seas Research (BNP Media's research unit) with The ACHR News
achr.author: Dylan Kurt
achr.importantQuote: a whopping 91% of respondents rate online reviews as an important factor for them when choosing an HVAC contractor (26% extremely, 35% very, 30% important)
achr.googleQuote: 56% of respondents saying they use Google to seek out reviews of contractors
achr.contractorQuote: Among the contractors surveyed, 45% reported they do answer reviews on third-party sites, with 43% saying they don't, and 13% saying they "don't know."
achr.contractorScope: The article does not give the number of contractors surveyed or say in so many words that they are HVAC contractors; the study is the HVAC trade paper's and is framed around choosing an HVAC contractor. Said 'in one HVAC survey, forty-three percent of contractors don't answer reviews' and 'on third-party sites'; never 'HVAC contractors' as a fixed population, never 'half'. The three shares sum to 101 (rounding on the page).
achr.smallShops: Contractors with 1 to 10 employees were the least likely to answer reviews on third-party sites (caption context only).
achr.notUsed: '88% of people prefer businesses that respond to all reviews' is a quote from a vendor inside the article, about general consumers, source not given: not used (bank do-not-use list).

replies.source: OURS: advice, not a finding (the bank's two-reply takeaway, reworded; the reviews, the furnace, the late tech and the shop are examples)
replies.five1: Thanks for trusting us with your furnace.
replies.five3: We're here when you need us.
replies.oneStarReview: 1 star. The tech showed up late.
replies.one1: Sorry we were late. That's on us.
replies.one2: I want to make it right.
replies.one3: Call me directly at the shop.
replies.note: replies is the count of sample replies; fiveStars and oneStar are the example reviews' ratings; minutes is our suggested weekly block (advice, not data)
